biography: I buy real estate and start companies. Owner of Somewhere, Bolt Storage, RE Cost Seg, and more.

latest_posts.caption: My real estate career in 1 minute:

You don’t have to control everything.

Win the important battles.

Give your kids structure.

But let them live a real life.

They need to learn how to socialize, take risks, and grow.

I once quit alcohol for 6 weeks. 

I noticed nothing. 

Only less time with friends, laughter, less vibrant conversation. Went home earlier. Said no to more social things.

Started drinking casually again.

All those things returned!

A great idea poorly executed is worth nothing. 

Execution > Ideas.

Fathers:

PLEASE do not let your children play video games for hours on end.

There is an epidemic. Kids don't want to be outside. They don't chase girls. They don't want to drive.

Stop the video games before your kid winds up 40 years old, single and in your basement.

The real epidemic:

- sports betting
- pornography

The second ruins your sex life and your marriage. The first ruins the rest of your life.

I will teach my children business. 

How to run businesses, make money, hire, manage, sell.

They won’t be artists, doctors, lawyers, athletes. 

They’ll have freedom and get wealthy.
Cut complainers out of your life. They're contagious and only slow you down!
Don’t get so obsessed with the big outcome that you overlook the next small win.
